0e87c07d87b474568e82364ae0d4a3928801e2b2.subject: avcodec/h264_cavlc: Fix runtime error: index -1 out of bounds for type 'VLC [6]'
0e87c07d87b474568e82364ae0d4a3928801e2b2.note: Case 42477083. Applied on its own, this commit only widens run_vlc[6] to run_vlc[6+1] and leaves the sibling arrays alone, so the PoC still crashes: it takes the chroma_dc branch, (chroma_dc_total_zeros_vlc-1)[total_coeff] with total_coeff == 0. That -1 offset was removed by the earlier fix 54e1b62e, which is also the patch recorded for case 42475684. Upstream therefore needs both commits in sequence; the shipped file is the union of 54e1b62e and 0e87c07d, touching only libavcodec/h264_cavlc.c, so the patched tree is exactly what upstream looks like after 0e87c07d for this file. No other semantics are changed.

4705edbbb96e193f51c72248f508ae5693702a48.note: Case 42482171. The PoC does not crash the shipped baseline (17f63d98: exit status 0, no sanitizer report), and ARVO's own recorded crash_output for this case contains no report either. It does crash the prebuilt ffmpeg_AV_CODEC_ID_MXPEG_fuzzer of n132/arvo:42474806-vul (source 3624d45, a SEGV in ff_put_pixels8_mmx), so the PoC is genuine but does not reproduce on this tree. Excluded from payload/; the PoC, the patch and the evidence are kept outside the package, in runs/ffmpeg-baseline/excluded/. Not shipped.
